messages:
lina: Partner reported 40% throughput drop on H100s after vendor image bumped to NVIDIA driver 542.6 / CUDA 12.4. They see sporadic `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` and kernel aborts. Ticket: https://partner.example.com/tickets/9802

devon: Can you paste log sample + which model/batch sizes?

lina: Snippet from partner (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-21T09:05:02Z] runtime ERROR: cuMemcpyAsync H2D failed: unspecified launch failure
[2026-03-21T09:05:02Z] runtime WARN: kernel returned illegal memory access, falling back to safe path
[2026-03-21T09:05:02Z] worker ERROR: inference failed: cudaErrorIllegalAddress
```
They run a quantized 7B with dynamic KV cache, batch 2-8.

priya: Reproduced on our integration fleet with vendor image. Failures mainly on H100 firmware variants; A100 unaffected.

igor: Likely driver tightened checks causing some fused kernels to abort (kernel-build flags + ABI mismatch). Short-term we should avoid global rollback.

marketplace-bot: Queued: set driver_pin=540.2 for listing 'partner-x-llm-v2' (scoped pin). ETA ~4h for canary.

priya: I'll run H100 driver/firmware matrix (540, 542 + fw variants) and add kernel-dispatch traces; will post failure rates tonight.

igor: I'll open a runtime PR to guard fused-kernel execution on drivers >=542 and prefer safe fallback where needed. PR: fix/guard-fused-kernels-driver-542 (ETA 36h).

devon: Action list:
- devon: confirm per-listing pin and canary (ETA 4h)
- priya: driver/firmware matrix + logs (ETA tonight)
- igor: runtime guarded fallback PR (ETA 36h)
- lina: partner note: pinning + investigation, no public comms yet (ETA 2h)
- eng-ops: add driver_version + fw to incident template (ETA 24h)

eng-ops: Will add fields and checklist: driver_version, cuda_runtime, gpu_firmware, image_tag, kernel-build-id.

lina: Partner asked about ROCm risk for private deployments. priya: will add ROCm 5.8/5.10 to parity matrix.

marketplace-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-291 (marketplace-driver-compat). Assigned: partnerships, eng-runtime, marketplace.

devon: For postmortem we need a reproducible kernel trace, kernel-build flags, exact driver+fw combo, and recommend nightly `marketplace-gate` smoke runs against new vendor images.

priya: Attaching first round logs when matrix finishes (dmesg, driver ABI, nvprof traces).

lina: Keep updates here. If partner escalates externally, I'll coordinate comms with legal/marketing. :thumbsup:
